delivery.offline: after assets are cached; not yet guaranteed

notes: This is an experimental browser prototype, not a production game release.
N-BI consumes 10 Mana per successful Chaos shot in the current prototype; upgrade-based cost reduction is not yet implemented.
No server account or cloud save exists.
Random game is selected on each fresh launch; a running round stays fixed until ended or page reload.
Generation 1.4 adds an independent 320x180 pixel-art city layer with local dawn/day/dusk/night phases and reduced-motion handling.
The adaptive runtime file remains unchanged; pixel-world quality is adjusted after the existing calibration.
Pixel skyline is procedural placeholder art and is not yet a canonical, source-confirmed Niroo City illustration.

pixelWorld.reducedMotion: static scene; redraw only on time-phase changes
